assessments.name: Business identity
assessments.prompt: Does a legally registered entity exist, is it active, and is the submitted identity the same one as the registered one.

assessments.name: Ownership
assessments.prompt: Who is behind it, and whether that can be established at all. Officers, control persons, submitted people, and what the record cannot reach.

assessments.name: Activity
assessments.prompt: Whether it is actually operating — address, website, connections, the shape of the footprint.

assessments.name: Compliance and screening
assessments.prompt: Watchlist, PEP, adverse media, liens, litigation, bankruptcy, industry.
